newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Canada sees move to neutral monetary stance.
newsitem.headline: Bank Canada sees move to neutral monetary stance.

text.p: Bank of Canada Governor Gordon Thiessen said on Thursday the bank would need to move toward a neutral stance from its now stimulative stance as slack was taken up in the economy.

"The assessment we made in November that there was still a risk the inflation rate might fall between our one to three percent target band, and that may require easing the monetary conditions -- we have essentially said that that risk looks to us to have disappeared," Thiessen told a news conference.
